verdict.rationale: Clara documents a public REST API covering cards, transactions, users, and invoices. It backs this with a docs-derived OpenAPI 3.1 schema, self-serve credentials, a sandbox, runnable code examples, and an LLM-optimized API reference, and probes confirmed that openapi.json, llms.txt, and the markdown docs are live. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of actually driving the API end-to-end (evidence is first-party docs plus availability probes only).
